description: Enables instances in a private subnet to connect to outbound internet services safely.

sections.title: Gateway Settings
sections.description: Subnet placement, public connectivity, and Elastic IP binding

fields.label: Public Subnet ID
fields.why: NAT Gateways must be positioned in a Public Subnet with a route to an Internet Gateway.
fields.impact: Recreates the NAT Gateway if changed, temporarily severing outbound internet connectivity for private subnets.

fields.label: Connectivity Mode
fields.why: Private NAT Gateways do not require an EIP and are used for overlapping internal networks.
fields.impact: Private connectivity mode prevents outbound access to the public internet.
